findings.reason: Step 3.1 needs the scalar-endomorphism argument for proportionality of invariant forms: Schur gives a division ring, while absolute simplicity and algebraic closedness of C give End=C. Explicitly identify the restricted form on the rightmost-defect submodule with G_{n-1,p}. In step 4.1, B must be invertible by the induction hypothesis, not merely nonzero. The cited full treatment confirms this block recurrence and its invertibility requirements: [Ridout–Saint-Aubin, §4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.4505).

The induction hypothesis in step 2.1 omits that the identity coefficient of p_r is 1. Step 4.1 uses that property for P to conclude the next projector is nonzero. Carry ε(p_r)=1 as an induction invariant and show the correction term has identity coefficient zero.
Step 1.3 likewise needs ε(p_r)=1 in its induction hypothesis before concluding ε(p_{r+1})=1. State and carry this normalization invariant through the recursion.
The Statement uses “normalized” while steps 1.1 and 2.1 require ε(e)=1. Define the convention explicitly in Facts as ε(e)=1; this does not change the claim.
